task.title: Add localStorage quota protection and storage usage indicator
task.description:
Three changes: (1) Wrap the s() function body in a try/catch: function s(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){if(e.name==='QuotaExceededError'){showStorageWarning();}}} Add function showStorageWarning(){if(document.getElementById('storageWarn'))return;const el=document.createElement('div');el.id='storageWarn';el.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;background:var(--red);color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:10px;font-size:13px;z-index:9999;';el.innerHTML='Storage nearly full. Export your data to free space.';document.body.prepend(el);} (2) In the Settings view, add a storage usage line above the Save button:
. Populate it in loadSettings(): const keys=Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k=>k.startsWith('renzo'));const used=keys.reduce((t,k)=>t+(localStorage.getItem(k)||'').length,0);document.getElementById('storageUsage').textContent='Storage: '+(used/1024).toFixed(1)+' KB used'; (3) In the contacts table, if contacts.length > 50, add simple pagination: show only contacts slice [page*50,(page+1)*50], add Previous/Next buttons below the table, and a count 'Showing X-Y of Z contacts'. Add a page state variable and wire the buttons.

blocking_issues: Mobile navigation completely broken - 230px fixed sidebar cannot collapse/hide on mobile, making app unusable on small screens
Modal overlays not scrollable on mobile when content exceeds viewport - users cannot access form fields or buttons
Table horizontal overflow not handled - wide tables will break layout on mobile with no scroll mechanism
Touch targets below minimum 44x44px - nav items (9px padding), buttons (btn-xs at 4px padding), and modal close buttons fail accessibility standards

Queue actions missing: Users can see queued messages but there's no visible way to edit or delete them before sending - only a 'Send' button is rendered. Need Edit/Delete buttons to prevent accidentally sending wrong messages.
AI Guide modal not responsive on mobile - fixed 340px width breaks on small screens, bottom positioning (90px) may overlay navigation, no viewport constraints for max-height: 480px on short screens
No skip link for keyboard users to bypass sidebar navigation - accessibility violation
Modal overlays lack proper focus trap - keyboard users can tab to elements behind modal
No aria-labels or screen reader text for icon-only buttons (modal close button shows only ×)
Forms missing associated error announcements for screen readers when validation fails
Color-only differentiation for priority/tier badges - fails WCAG for color blindness
No visible focus indicators on sidebar navigation items for keyboard navigation
Missing error handling for sendEmail onclick - function call references queued message ID but no error state if contact email is missing/invalid
Activity expansion toggle references toggleActivity function that isn't shown in chunk - if missing, all activity items will break on click
